answer: Each epoch, on-chain randomness audits a random 1% of identities: each audited identity must present a fresh liveness proof plus its 20 POA stake receipt within 24 hours or forfeit the stake and freeze payouts. A lone willow bends in one wind, but a sybil herd cannot wander past the lottery — every extra fake adds another audit ticket and another 20 POA at risk, so expected losses climb with the herd while honest users pay once. Audit draws and proofs sit on-chain like juniper roots, letting any verifier replay the selection and check each receipt.
